ingameEffects.label: Fire! (W-Engine Passive)
ingameEffects.description: The equipper gains 1 Charge stack every 3s, stacking up to 6 times. When launching an EX Special Attack, consumes all Charge stacks and each stack consumed increases the skill's Daze inflicted.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: This w-engine does not affect the equipper's stats.
